"""Drive the released matrix CLI through a bounded CPU rehearsal."""

import csv
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path


COLUMNS = ("vanilla", "synaptic_off", "add_hebbian")
SEEDS = (1337, 1338)
RECIPE = ("--depth=1 --max_seq_len=64 --device_batch_size=2 --total_batch_size=128 --num_iterations=1 "
          "--eval_every=1 --eval_tokens=128 --core_metric_every=-1 --sample_every=-1 --device_type=cpu")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]


def launch(root, name, argv, env, *, succeeds=True):
    output = root / f"{name}.log"
    errors = root / f"{name}.stderr.log"
    started = time.monotonic()
    peak = {}
    with output.open("xb") as stream, errors.open("xb") as stderr:
        child = subprocess.Popen(argv, env=env, stdout=stream, stderr=stderr)
        while child.poll() is None:
            for pid in descendants(child.pid):
                try:
                    arguments = (Path("/proc") / str(pid) / "cmdline").read_bytes().decode().split("\0")
                    tag = next((value.split("=", 1)[1] for value in arguments if value.startswith("--model_tag=")), None)
                    if tag is not None:
                        status = (Path("/proc") / str(pid) / "status").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                        value = next(line.split()[1] for line in status.splitlines() if line.startswith("VmHWM:"))
                        peak[tag] = max(peak.get(tag, 0), int(value) * 1024)
                except (OSError, UnicodeError, StopIteration):
                    continue
            time.sleep(0.2)
    text = output.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    err = errors.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    assert (child.returncode == 0) == succeeds, (name, child.returncode, text[-3000:], err[-3000:])
    evidence = {"argv": argv, "exit_code": child.returncode, "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
                "log_sha256": digest(output), "stderr_sha256": digest(errors), "sampled_peak_rss": peak}
    return text if succeeds else text + err, evidence


def descendants(pid):
    pending = [pid]
    found = []
    while pending:
        parent = pending.pop()
        try:
            path = Path(f"/proc/{parent}/task/{parent}/children")
            children = list(map(int, path.read_text().split()))
            found.extend(children)
            pending.extend(children)
        except OSError:
            continue
    return found


def main(work, common):
    stage = work / "matdata"
    stage.mkdir()
    for item in ("base_data", "tokenizer"):
        (stage / item).symlink_to(common / item, target_is_directory=True)
    env = {**os.environ, "NANOCHAT_BASE_DIR": str(stage), "BIO_RESULTS_REGISTRY": str(stage / "registry.jsonl"),
           "PYTHONWARNINGS": "ignore"}
    base = [sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.matrix_launch", "--stage", "screening", "--exploratory",
            "--columns", ",".join(COLUMNS), "--seeds", ",".join(map(str, SEEDS)), f"--recipe={RECIPE}"]
    plan, planned = launch(work, "plan", [*base, "--plan"], env)
    planned_score = shlex.split(plan.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    assert planned_score[:4] == [sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.eval_matrix", "matrix"]
    manifest_path = Path(planned_score[planned_score.index("--matrix-manifest") + 1])
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_bytes())
    assert manifest["stage"] == "screening" and not manifest["registered"] and manifest["cap_gpu_hours"] is None
    assert manifest["columns"] == list(COLUMNS) and manifest["seeds"] == list(SEEDS)
    attempts = manifest_path.parent / "attempts.jsonl"
    assert not attempts.exists()
    log, trained = launch(work, "train", [*base, "--execute"], env)
    score = shlex.split(log.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    assert score == planned_score
    training_argv = [shlex.split(line) for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith(sys.executable)
                     and "-m scripts.base_train " in line]
    assert len(training_argv) == len(COLUMNS) * len(SEEDS)
    _, scored = launch(work, "score", score, env)
    summary, = Path(score[score.index("--out-dir") + 1]).rglob("summary.csv")
    with summary.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
        measured = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
    assert {(item["preset"], int(item["seed"])) for item in measured} == {
        (column, seed) for column in COLUMNS for seed in SEEDS}
    assert len(measured) == 6
    for item in measured:
        assert item["recipe_source"] == "base_train_checkpoint" and math.isfinite(float(item["val_bpb"]))
        assert item["matrix_stage"] == "screening" and item["matrix_manifest_digest"] == manifest["run_id"]
        assert item["eval_data_digest"] == manifest["data"]["val_sha256"]
        assert int(item["checkpoint_step"]) == 1
        tag = manifest["checkpoint_template"].format(preset=item["preset"], seed=item["seed"])
        events = rows(Path("runs/telemetry") / tag / "events.jsonl")
        updates = [event for event in events if event["event"] == "train_step"]
        assert len(updates) == 1 and updates[0]["step"] == 0 and updates[0]["divergence_action"] == "OK"
        meta_path = stage / "base_checkpoints" / tag / "meta_000001.json"
        meta = json.loads(meta_path.read_bytes())
        assert meta["user_config"]["matrix_run_id"] == manifest["run_id"]
        assert meta["matrix_data"] == manifest["data"] and meta["model_config"]["init_seed"] == int(item["seed"])
        if item["preset"] != "vanilla":
            assert meta["synaptic_config"]["enable_hebbian"] == (item["preset"] == "add_hebbian")
        item["optimizer_updates"] = len(updates)
        item["measured_tok_per_sec"] = updates[0]["tok_per_sec"]
        item["sampled_peak_rss_bytes"] = trained["sampled_peak_rss"][tag]
        item["checkpoint_metadata_sha256"] = digest(meta_path)
    before = digest(attempts)
    refused, duplicate = launch(work, "duplicate", [*base, "--execute"], env, succeeds=False)
    assert "run already exists" in refused
    _, restarted = launch(work, "restart", [*base, "--execute", "--restart"], env)
    assert before == digest(attempts)
    wrong = list(score)
    wrong[3] = "run"
    _, wrong_subcommand = launch(work, "wrong-subcommand", wrong, env, succeeds=False)
    stale = list(score)
    stale[stale.index("--checkpoint-step") + 1] = "0"
    _, stale_step = launch(work, "stale-step", stale, env, succeeds=False)
    dup_seeds = list(base)
    dup_seeds[dup_seeds.index("--seeds") + 1] = "1337,1337"
    _, duplicate_seed = launch(work, "duplicate-seed", [*dup_seeds, "--plan"], env, succeeds=False)
    paired = {}
    for comparator, candidate in (("vanilla", "synaptic_off"), ("synaptic_off", "add_hebbian")):
        path = work / f"vs-{comparator}.json"
        _, command = launch(work, f"paired-{comparator}", [sys.executable, "-m", "bio_inspired_nanochat.eval_stats",
                           str(summary), "--baseline", comparator, "--min-pairs", "2", "--json-out", str(path)], env)
        data = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
        entry = data["presets"][candidate]
        assert entry["paired_vs_baseline"]["n_pairs"] == len(SEEDS)
        paired[candidate] = {"comparator": comparator, "verdict": entry, "command": command}
    evidence = {"manifest": manifest, "training_argv": training_argv, "cells": measured, "attempts": rows(attempts),
                "commands": {"plan": planned, "train": trained, "score": scored, "restart": restarted,
                             "duplicate": duplicate, "wrong_subcommand": wrong_subcommand,
                             "stale_step": stale_step, "duplicate_seed": duplicate_seed},
                "paired_exploratory_verdicts": paired}
    with (work / "rehearsal.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(evidence, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(f"{len(measured)} of 6 matrix cells reached trained metadata and scorer output.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The rehearsal requires assertions.")
    main(*map(Path, sys.argv[1:]))
